description: Repairs r-cplx-rebuild/options-collation: the strings ch and ll of the rich fixtures do not separate Spanish traditional from General. A new ACCDB and a new MDB each hold S(ID COUNTER key, V TEXT(10)) with the values cz, ch, ci, d, lz, ll, m, z, a, o, ä (U+00E4) and ö (U+00F6). Each is compacted with DBEngine.CompactDatabase(source, output, DstLocale) to the General (0x0409), Spanish traditional (0x040A) and Swedish (0x041D) sort order locales (DBEngine.Errors right before and after); each output's CollatingOrder is read and SELECT V FROM S ORDER BY V, ID and the rows with V between 'ch' and 'd' are read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
